status: source-reviewed temporal transformations; provider raw-statistic definitions remain separate documentation work

common.scope: Canonical source state after the observed week, used for a later target game; team-season histories reset at season boundaries. No target-game observations enter these transforms.
common.reconstruction_inputs: n is completed game count, m is the current cumulative source mean; n_prev is the greatest prior nonmissing count, m_prev the latest prior nonmissing mean. Append only finite reconstructed contributions x when n advances. When counts advance by more than one, x is that batch contribution average, not individually recovered games.
common.history_update: After each source row, update n_prev=MAX(n_prev,n) when n is present and update m_prev=m when m is present, even if no contribution was appended. Missing count/mean or bye rows do not append a new observation.
common.garbage_time_handling: No new temporal play filter; retain the inherited source statistic filtering. Provider-side historical filtering is not reconstructed by these transforms.
common.minimum_sample_rule: One finite reconstructed contribution enables level/trend states. Population volatility is zero at one contribution; it is missing before any contribution. Missing current source mean makes the recent-minus-season difference missing.
common.source_inspiration: TDNet-derived temporal transforms, implemented in the hash-bound source. Provider PPA, success and explosiveness terminology: https://github.com/sportsdataverse/cfbfastR/blob/main/R/cfbd_play.R (PPA per play; explosiveness is average PPA on successful plays).
